name: United States

flag.description: Thirteen horizontal stripes alternating red and white, starting and ending with red, with a blue rectangle in the upper hoist holding 50 white five-pointed stars in nine offset rows of six and five.
flag.symbolism: The 13 stripes represent the original colonies and the 50 stars the states; red is traditionally said to signify valour, white purity and blue vigilance and justice.

hook: The United States: 50 stars and 13 stripes; Liberia has 11 stripes and one big star, and Malaysia adds a crescent.
trivia: The 50-star flag became official on 4 July 1960 and has been in use longer than any earlier version.
Six American flags were planted on the Moon during the Apollo landings between 1969 and 1972.
